scenario: Ready tasks exceed integration review or evidence merge capacity.

expect.outcome: Cap concurrency at narrowest active constraint.

scenario: Whole-stage barrier blocks disjoint-file tasks with no consumed artifact.

expect.outcome: Reject unnecessary serialization and permit parallel work.

scenario: Downstream authoring and fixture preparation do not consume producer runtime proof.
Integration or activation starts before required producer verifies.

expect.outcome: Deny activation until required producer proof exists.

scenario: Tasks share file, commit, pin, or push ownership.

expect.outcome: Serialize shared writers and delivery operations.

scenario: Independent tasks have separate files and no consumed artifact.

expect.outcome: Admit parallel execution within declared capacity.
